[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested food and drinks include Krabby Patties, an ice cream bar, and "Frozen" fruit kabobs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested party favors for SpongeBob include Krabby Patty keychains, SpongeBob stickers or tattoos, jellyfish glow sticks, and Bikini Bottom beach balls.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested party favors for Elsa include snowflake wands, Frozen-themed stickers, coloring books, and ice blue candies.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested hiring a professional photographer, asking a family member or friend, or creating a DIY photo booth for capturing party moments.
